items.title: Church & Dwight (CHD) Takes A Minority Stake In European Hair Care Brands
items.summary: Church & Dwight (NYSE:CHD) disclosed a significant minority stake in BALI Treatment GmbH, owner of BALI CURLS and BALI GENTS hair care brands. The agreement includes an option for Church & Dwight to acquire full ownership of BALI Treatment GmbH at a later date. The deal gives Church & Dwight a potential entry point into the European hair care market through the BALI CURLS and BALI GENTS lines.
